title_candidates: MicroPython in WebAssembly shows a safer path for agent code
summary: Simon Willison released an alpha MicroPython-in-WebAssembly sandbox and used it to give Datasette Agent a more constrained way to run generated Python.

primary_source.title: Running Python code in a sandbox with MicroPython and WASM
primary_source.author: Simon Willison
key_facts: Willison released an alpha package called micropython-wasm.
The package runs MicroPython through WebAssembly for constrained Python execution.
A Datasette Agent plugin uses the package to run small generated Python examples.

prerequisites: A GitHub account for the Datasette Agent demo

steps.instruction: Use the Datasette Agent demo to request a small MicroPython example and inspect the generated code and output.

references.title: Running Python code in a sandbox with MicroPython and WASM
references.author: Simon Willison

risk_flags: The package is alpha software and should not be treated as proven security infrastructure.
